title: docs(spec): the TranslationDataSchema comment counts sixteen per-app groups, not fifteen
body:
Follow-up of #26170

## What changes

One word in a TSDoc comment. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, on `TranslationDataSchema`, said "Fifteen groups: every group the platform bundle declares EXCEPT `settings`". It now says "Sixteen groups".

## Why

The round-4 contract review on #26831 (comment 6458660736) found this one stale count. When #26831 merged main's `books` group (#26819), both parents had made the same Fourteen to Fifteen edit on this line, so git kept it without a conflict, and the hand pass that moved the other spelled counts did not reach it. At this head `appTranslationDataShape()` has sixteen keys, and the same comment block already calls the platform face "the seventeen-group face".

The line is a code comment only. It is not a `describe`, a refusal message, the JSON Schema or a generated doc, and no gate reads it.

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main` is one line in `translation.zod.ts` plus the patch changeset. `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` pass locally.
- `appTranslationDataShape()` at this head lists sixteen keys: objects, picklists, apps, messages, globalActions, dashboards, datasets, reports, pages, flows, hooks, positions, permissions, books, metadataForms, settingsCommon.
- The pre-push hook `check:commit-card-trailers` passed.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none, because no `skills/**` file states the per-app group count.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind (no names added).
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is left to CI for a one-word comment edit.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset (`.changeset/26170-translation-data-comment-count.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch).
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (a comment moves no generated artifact).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
